name: gridcraft-bridge
description: Build, edit, read and convert spreadsheets with the GridCraft app installed on Windows, macOS or Linux: sheets with live formulas, tables, formats, conditional formatting, charts and PivotTables, xlsx, csv, json, html and pdf. Not affiliated with GridCraft or Storytold.

gridcraft_dir.title: GridCraft folder
gridcraft_dir.description: Install folder of GridCraft (or GridCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\GridCraft, /Applications/GridCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/gridcraft or PATH.

gridcraft_cli.title: gridcraft-cli executable (optional)
gridcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped the gridcraft-cli zip on macOS.

control_port.title: GridCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the GridCraft app (open_in_gridcraft, run_gridcraft_commands live). Default 7979.
